=Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Jerry's background:
- Bilingual: English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing background with data science bootcamp training
- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Experience: dashboards, EDA, ML projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Job being applied to:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Why it fits: {{ $json.why_good_fit }}
Description excerpt:
{{ $json.description.substring(0, 800) }}

In the letter:
- Mention Jerry is Taiwan-based and works fully async/remotely
- Show specifically how Jerry can help this company:
  * Reduce manual analysis time
  * Improve reporting speed
  * Connect marketing and data
  * Build AI-assisted workflows
  * Turn messy data into business action
- Keep under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- No filler phrases

Return ONLY the cover letter text, no subject line, no greeting header.
